reviews.title: Has not been updated for years
reviews.text: No longer maintained or updated. Reliability is mixed.

reviews.title: Wrong
reviews.text: Giving me the wrong location despite having location on always as well as the wrong information. Multiple times it’s given me rain warnings with not a cloud in the sky, evidently never actually raining.

reviews.title: Not working
reviews.text:
Why is this not showing how much it raining?
It pissing down outside and the app shows nothing!!!

reviews.title: Poor & unsupported app
reviews.text: As i write this it is raining heavily. The app tells me it won’t rain for another 2 hours. The app hasn’t been updated for years and has become very unreliable. Enough said.

reviews.title: rain forecasts wrong
reviews.text:
App has suddenly stopped working. Says it can’t find radar and won’t load any pages at all and the help page will not open at all. The app is great when it’s working but it has suddenly stopped working and just won’t work at all now. it has Internet connectivity but just won’t load any data at all just everything is blank hope the devs can fix this.
Also the rain forecasts are wildly inaccurate!
